initialize.label: Start empty
initialize.story: The window is empty and the tally is blank.

grow.label: Add a tile
grow.story: Tile {right} is {char}; there are now {count} of it in the window. The most common colour appears {top} times, so this window of {size} needs {repaints} repaints.

slide.label: Slide instead of growing
slide.story: That is more than {k}, so the leftmost tile ({char}) leaves the window, which moves from {from} to {to}. The window keeps its size.

measure:record.label: Measure
measure:record.story: The window now holds {size} tiles, the longest so far.

measure:keep.label: Measure
measure:keep.story: The window holds {size} tiles; the best stays {best}.

done.label: Return the longest
done.story: The longest stretch that can be made one colour is {best} tiles.
